name: 29-sui de Renqi Xiang Chengwei Zhiye Coser Shifou Gaocuo le Shenme?
original_name: 29歲的人妻想成為職業coser是否搞錯了什麼？
source:
Your wife's almost thirty, and she loves cosplay more than anything. So this year, she made a vow: to try her hand at becoming a professional cosplayer and take the internet by storm! And you... Well, as her husband, it's your duty to help your hot wife fulfill her dreams!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3571750]Steam[/url]]

你妻子快三十了，她最喜欢角色扮演。所以今年，她立下誓言：要尝试成为一名职业coser，风靡网络！而你……好吧，作为她的丈夫，你有责任帮助你的辣妹实现她的梦想！
